With affordable rooms and resort fees waived when you book through the WDF, it'll be great value for one of the biggest weeks on the WDF calendar.The six days of darts will also include the World Open and 2026 WDF World Championship Qualifiers, with full tournament schedules and details to be revealed in due course.Qualification criteria for the 2026 WDF World Masters has been updated and is available to view in the Rules section of the WDF website. A list of the already qualified players for this year's tournament has been published and can be found in the News section. Tags: WDF Majors WDF World Masters USA
